location: The junction leading to the cellar levels
physicalConditions: Maren is carrying a broken cart axle across her shoulders, sustaining pain and strain on her injured leg/shoulder.
The corridor beyond the junction is dark and damp.
A hairline fracture in the masonry has been cleared to allow passage without triggering a trap.
knowledgeEstablished: Elara identified a secondary mechanical trap involving a hidden latch, pulley system, and weight-sensitive trigger beneath the floor slab at the junction.
The trap was bypassed by slipping through a hairline fracture in the wall rather than breaking stone or using magic.
The mechanism is sensitive to uneven weight distribution, vibrations, and sound.
No magical residue was found on the trap mechanism; it relies on raw engineering.
decisionsMade: Torin assigned himself to guard the corridor ahead and react immediately to any sounds or movement.
The party paused at the junction floor to assess the two available routes into the cellar levels.
completedActions: Elias stepped back from the wall after bypassing the trap.
Torin positioned himself at the entrance of the corridor ahead, hand on sword pommel.
Elara stood up and handed Elias a small vial of loose quartz dust.
The party stands assembled at the junction threshold.
unresolvedImmediateAction: Elias holds the vial of quartz dust while the group prepares to assess the two available routes into the cellar levels.
continuationPosition: The group is positioned at the threshold of the cellar junction, looking toward the darkened corridor beyond where they must choose a route. Maren is managing her pain while holding the axle, and Elara has just handed Elias the dust for inspection.
